run_policy.protocol: Present each prompt as a Skill-selection task using only installed Skill names and descriptions. Open every selected SKILL.md so loading is observable, report selected names, and do not solve the underlying task.
run_policy.repetition_rule: Run each affected case once under matched baseline and candidate conditions, then repeat only after an unexpected or unstable selection.
run_policy.verdict_rule: Record pass, fail, unstable, not exposed, or not executed for every condition. Mixed observed results are unstable, not a pass.

cases.prompt: Turn these already organized findings, labels, evidence, impact, confidence, and locations into unposted GitHub PR inline comment drafts. Do not review the diff or post anything.
The findings, accept/defer decisions, follow-up timing, and Approve action are already decided. Draft a concise PR review summary and approval supplement without changing those decisions.
The findings already have assessment, state, Act now, Defer, or No action decisions, and review placement. Draft the applicable unposted PR comments without changing those decisions.
Review the current code, documentation, and configuration diff for new correctness, safety, compatibility, and test problems.
Evaluate these existing review findings and decide which to accept, defer, or reject, including implementation priority and response approach.
Re-review the updated diff, determine which previous findings are Resolved or Remaining, discover any New findings, and choose the review action.
Verify only whether the completed fix for finding F2 is resolved and report the checks, unconfirmed scope, and remaining risk.
The findings are accepted and scoped. Implement the fixes and run the relevant tests now.
The review comment drafts are final. Post the inline comments and submit the GitHub review now.
